title: The 2-Minute Rule That Eliminates Procrastination
script: The 2-minute rule says if a task takes less than 2 minutes, do it now instead of putting it off. Imagine your inbox is full. Instead of dreading it, just handle each email as it comes. Reply, delete, or file. No more backlog. The same goes for making your bed, washing one dish, or sending that quick email. Small wins create momentum. And momentum beats procrastination every time.
prompt_for_hailuo: Young professional sits at desk, stares at overflowing inbox [Static shot]. Opens laptop with sigh. Handles first email quickly [Tracking shot following hands on keyboard]. Smiles and marks complete [Push in on screen showing checkmark]. Handles second email, third email [Montage of quick wins]. Closes laptop satisfied, leans back [Pull out to show organized desk]. Modern office, bright morning light, productivity mood, dynamic camera movements.

She marks the final email complete with a satisfied exhale and leans back in her chair with a genuine warm smile and arms raised in quiet victory, the inbox showing '0 unread' on the screen glowing behind her in the bright home office morning light.
